name: Stocked Outpost's On Enter draws a card into memory
notes: Plays Stocked Outpost (a NORM siegeable domain, no element unlock needed) and confirms its On Enter ability draws a card into memory, on top of the two reserve payments that also move hand cards into memory. Does not cover the On Destroy trigger, which requires reducing its durability to 0 via siege combat damage.

rulesClauses: On Enter: Draw a card into your memory.
